guide_1_body: Work through six short sections covering your background, knowledge, skills, interests, preferences, and working style. Review every starting value before submitting.

guide_recency_body: Optional dates let the model reduce skill ratings that have gone unused. Blank dates leave your rating unchanged. These adjustments are estimates, not measurements of your ability.
guide_limitations_title: How should I use these recommendations?

guide_privacy_body: Your draft and learning checklist stay in this browser. Saved profiles use a private device access code; the server stores only its hash alongside your background and results in SQLite. Keep the access backup private: anyone with it can access your history. The dashboard lets you delete your server profile and local data. This is device-based access, not an email account or password recovery service.
guide_scores_body: A score reflects how the model ranks a career using your answers. It is not a calibrated probability of employment, aptitude, or success. The default model does not use the bundled mock market data.
guide_limitations_body: The release model uses 500 synthetic records across 12 technology careers. Its held-out test accuracy is 45%, with 79% top-three accuracy on 100 synthetic test records. Target-derived fields are excluded and preprocessing is fitted only on training data. These figures do not establish real-world suitability: compare results with projects, course experiences, and conversations with people in the field.
